QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 1
QuestInfo.0: Olaf of Lith Harbor offered to take me to numerous famous spots in the Maple World.
QuestInfo.1: According to Olaf, Riel will take me to the next stop. Where must that be?
QuestInfo.2: I was able to meet up with Riel. Where will I go next?

0.0: Hey, you! Care to experience something totally new?

yes.0: That's right! I like that attitude. I'll send you directly to Florina Beach. Once you get there, talk to #eRiel#k and she'll take you to another awesome spot.
yes.1: Yes, you'll encounter powerful monsters outside town, so if you aren't ready for them, I advise you to stay within town.

no.0: Oh ho, a young fella who has no wild side! You'd make a great accountant!

1.0: Oh, Olaf sent you here? Alright! Have yourself a watermelon here and chill. There's nothing quite like a cold watermelon under the glaring sun.
